sloka: हतस्य महिषस्यास्थि पादेनैकेन लक्ष्मण ।उद्यम्याथ प्रक्षिपेच्चेत्तरसा द्वे धनुश्शते ॥४-११-७२॥।।
transliteration: hatasya mahiṣasyāsthi pādenaikena lakṣmaṇa ।udyamyātha prakṣipeccettarasā dve dhanuśśate ॥4-11-72॥।।

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana and if Rama can also lift the dead buffalo's (Dundubhi's) skeleton and hurl it to a distance of two hundred bows with one of his feet.
